# Spell integration rules — provisional v0.1

Use this document with the [shared class rules](CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md), the class's own engine and the [spell packet](SPELL_PLAYTEST_STARTER.md). This is a staged development layer, not an approved-book replacement or a live companion update.

## What owns each decision

| Decision | Source used for this packet |
|---|---|
| Spell identity, every school placement and per-class rank/access | Preserved `src/data/spells.js`; do not collapse different class ranks into one global rank. |
| Common RP prices and additional spell evidence | Core Systems Known Descent V2. Its spell blocks are retained with the catalog summaries. |
| Class identity, engine, spellbook/preparation and cadence exceptions | The current class playtest packet. |
| Generic Dissonance/Refrain, action limits and core conditions | Shared class playtest rules; source Core conditions remain unchanged. |
| Missing targeting, exact endpoints, concentration ambiguities and exploit limits | Explicitly provisional decisions on each spell card. |

The approved Core V2 source has 936 spell blocks. The companion catalog has 848 unique IDs with 936 school placements, but leaves four metadata fields unspecified. These are different views of the source, not evidence that all casting details were absent. Core's generic “Automatic or opposed as described” does not supply a concrete save or targeting rule.

Eleven possible renamed entries remain comparative evidence in the register. Harmonic Bulwark's catalog summary says 5 temporary HP per RP while the possible historical Mana Shield entry says 2; its [individual transformation and buffer review](TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md) now supplies the operational decision. Both source variants remain preserved. Other unresolved aliases stay pending their own review; matching names never silently merge effects.

Resonance Kindle now has [exact manuscript approval](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_CANTRIP_EXACT_REVIEW.md): Action/Self/V/S, recover 1 RP only when this spell reaches resolution. Its one character-wide use is spent at legal cast start and refreshes only on a beneficial completed long rest. The comparative Mana Kindle block remains separately preserved; its broader wording does not trigger recovery from other cantrips and its historical range grants no remote recipient. The [Conjuration cantrip status](CONJURATION_CANTRIP_REVIEW_STATUS.json) records this bounded decision and the other eleven approved cards.

## Select a spell

1. Choose the class through which you are learning/casting it. Check that class's school access and minimum **class** level on the card.
2. Use that class's spell rank and Core V2 cost. A different eligible class may receive the same spell at a different rank and level.
3. Record it in your allowed known, prepared or spellbook choices. An eligible catalog entry is not an automatic grant. Wizard and Druid keep their explicit preparation systems; fallback counts apply only where the class has no more specific rule.
4. Select only a spell marked `operational-playtest-draft` in this packet, or an operational spell expressly supplied by a class card. Other records stay visible in the unfinished queue.
5. A class card and an ordinary spell with the same name remain separate records with separate acquisition and costs. Knowing one does not grant the other. Oath spells, Matrix techniques and similar class spells use their own card.

Oracle uses RC and its Mystery/Curse system. Soldier and Warrior have no general Weave access. Dragoon first gains ordinary magic at class 3; Paladin at class 2. Sufficient RP, total character level, a class feature with the same name, or a borrowed spellbook cannot bypass a gate.

## Resolve a cast at the table

1. Verify the available Action/Bonus Action/Reaction, its exact trigger, components, targets, range and line of effect. No legal target means no activation or payment. A target in an area still needs the card's eligibility. Total cover blocks direct targeting unless expressly overridden.
2. Choose a spell from your actual repertoire. Determine its class-specific rank and RP cost: rank 0–9 costs **0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26**. Add explicitly printed extra costs; Resonance Shield adds 1 RP even when the caster receives it as a cantrip. Generic Overcast is excluded.
3. Read Dissonance **before** casting. Limit = max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, casting modifier)). At limit/limit+3/limit+6, ranked spells cost +1/+2/+3 RP. At limit+6 ordinary rank-1+ casting is blocked. Cantrips have no strain surcharge but still build Refrain. An expressly granted traumatic-casting exception pays the cost and its printed trauma; it grants neither rank nor repertoire access.
4. Commit the legal cast's RP, materials and other printed costs before any attack/save or interruption. Perform its components and establish concentration if required, ending incompatible prior concentration. An ordinary missed, saved-against or countered legal cast refunds nothing and never restores displaced concentration.
5. At this cast's beginning, apply ordinary Dissonance and Refrain once: 0 base for rank 0, 1 for ranks 1–5, 2 for ranks 6–9; consecutive same-named casts add Refrain +1/+2/+3, capped at +3. First cast or a different name adds +0. Apply the class's exact protected reduction, routing or vent and any hook whose printed trigger is beginning/casting. Weapon or idle turns do not reset the previous name/Refrain unless the class expressly says so. This chronological commitment occurs before the Counterspell window; a later Reaction cast updates its own history, and resuming the earlier cast does not update that history again.
6. Open legal cast-interruption Reactions, resolving nested counters last-in, first-out. A surviving cast then resolves its effect: spell attacks are d20 + PB + the actual casting ability modifier; save DC is 8 + PB + that modifier. Use the exact card's hit/failure/success results and ordinary damage/conditions. Outcome-dependent class hooks occur only at their printed timing and with the required actual result. No automatic cantrip scaling applies. A negated spell grants no success/hit/damage effect merely because its casting cost was paid.
7. Record concentration, exact expiration, per-rest use, summon and companion command obligations. A second spell cannot supply an ungranted Action, duplicate concentration or resource reset. A readied spell commits this casting sequence at preparation; release has no second cast, cost, cadence update or Counterspell window.

Countering requires an actual operational spell or class card, its repertoire/access and a legal remaining Reaction. The ordinary Counterspell is now reviewed; it is separate from the Mage and Wizard class cards. Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) and Dispel Magic use their exact individual scopes. Rank-limited dispels inspect the original generating cast's spell rank, not RP cost or the dispeller's rank. Higher and unassigned source variants retain their own unfinished status.

## Counterspell checks and interruption

The [exact notebook review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_ABJURATION_RANK2_3_EXACT_REVIEW.md) confirms this authored timing interface and corrects the earlier binary-check proposal using the existing [Core roll rules](CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md). This is a tabletop procedure; the pricing helper does not implement nested reactions.

Ordinary Counterspell uses its casting class's actual spellcasting ability + PB against **DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank**. The class Wizard/Mage cards retain their printed Intelligence + PB check and their own acquisition, cost, rank and recharge. Apply the existing fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts, then collapse Critical Success/Success to success and Failure/Critical Failure to failure. No extra critical counter effect is invented. It is neither a spell attack nor a saving throw.

| Natural d20 + modifier | DC | Existing task result | Counter result |
|---|---:|---|---|
| 20 + 0 | 22 | Failure improves to Success | Success |
| 1 + 9 | 10 | Success worsens to Failure | Failure |
| 1 + 20 | 10 | Critical Success worsens to Success | Success |

The target must be an actual pending spell with a recorded rank. The Director may use hidden source data without revealing the spell's identity/rank; attempting grants no free identification. An unassigned rank is not automatically zero. A source-defined technique is not counterable merely because it spends RP or resembles magic.

A creature normally attempts Counterspell once against a particular pending cast, across its ordinary and same-named class sources. Another Reaction alone does not supply another attempt. An exact source expressly granting an additional attempt against that same cast overrides the default. After failure, another eligible creature may react; after negation there is no further trigger. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out and resume surviving parents without recasting, paying again, or replaying their earlier Refrain/Dissonance. Negation refunds no costs and restores no prior concentration. Countering one spell is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that combined ledger.


## Reviewed placement-specific cards

Detect Poison has Divination rank-0 and Abjuration rank-1 modes. The casting class's preserved school/rank selects the mode; the rank-1 mode also requires F. Alignment Shield has Abjuration rank-1/30-foot and Conjuration rank-3/60-foot modes; its 60-foot header represents only the maximum range across modes. Read each full target and resolution field. These are manuscript rules; the pricing helper does not execute targeting or components.

Repulsion Field's operational entry is only the rank-1 object pulse. Its distinct rank-6 creature effect remains preserved but unavailable. Warding Bond uses its preserved rank-1 class access; the rank-2 duplicate grants no extra effect. Higher character level or extra RP never grants a blocked placement or changes modes. All source variants remain in the catalog's source evidence.

Alignment Sanctuary has Abjuration rank-3 admission saves and the actually granted Shaman Conjuration rank-6 matching-alignment mode. The unassigned rank-6 Abjuration benefits remain unavailable. Identity counts do not close every preserved placement; consult the [variant register](SPELL_VARIANT_REVIEW_STATUS.json).

Ordinary Warding Bond follows the reviewed damage-sharing stage/root rules and its exact card. It does not use or enlarge the Paladin class redirection round ledger or grant named Paladin healing/resource riders. Its authored promotion does not establish an implementation of its effect in the damage-sharing reference helper.

## Reviewed finite conjurations

The [rank-1 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK1_EXACT_REVIEW.md) selects **2 RP** for Summon Mod Rod under the manifest's Core V2 spellcasting precedence; the conflicting V6/catalog 1-RP wording remains preserved. Its charge and separate character-wide caster supply/recipient receipt uses commit at activation start, including prevented or zero recovery, and refresh only on each character's beneficial completed long rest. Replacing rods never resets those records.

Read the [exact cards](SPELL_PLAYTEST_STARTER.md) for each created object's weight, native HP, duration, custody, load and ending. Summon Minor Weapon is wielded through ordinary weapon actions; it grants no attack on casting. Conjure Rope and Resonance Bridge require real support and apply ordinary Falling on failure. Alignment Essence preserves its empty result-vial for one minute after full consumption. Faction Messenger conserves supplied mundane paper and cannot resolve an ambiguous recipient description magically. Heat Metal keeps its physical-item round record and six-second next-pulse deadline through recasting, handoff and initiative changes. These are authored procedures; [review status](CONJURATION_RANK1_REVIEW_STATUS.json) does not certify runtime or balance.

## Components, summons and ongoing effects

**V** requires audible speech; **S** requires a free hand or a class feature expressly permitting the gesture; **F** is the class's ordinary casting focus. Core's M/F shorthand is interpreted here as the existing focus alternative. No unspecified costly or consumed material is added. These hand/focus conventions are provisional and may require equipment integration. A spell with V is blocked by an effect explicitly preventing verbal casting.

Summon stat blocks use their printed AC/HP/attack die. Where absent, saves use the owner's PB, other ability checks use +0, walking Speed is 30 feet, and there are no unstated creature immunities or extraordinary senses. Unless a card explicitly gives another bounded range, a commanded companion must be within 60 feet and able to perceive its owner. All one owner's companions share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging action total per round**. Without a command they move and Dodge. A replacement requires the full casting cost. No summon grants loot, a reusable corpse or resource-generating death trigger.

The [rank-2 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK2_EXACT_REVIEW.md) approves this specific companion overlay: **when an exact companion source prints multiple attacks as one damaging action, those attacks are components of one commanded offensive action and consume the owner's single offensive-companion allowance unless that source expressly grants otherwise.** Summon Air Pet explicitly makes its two source attacks within that one action; no second command/action or remaining offense for another companion is created. Its fixed AC15/HP20/two 1d6 attacks do not inherit generic companion scaling.

Planar Ally (Minor) uses a finite NEW summon-only profile for the source's intended CR-1 role. The bounded public bestiary scan did not establish an eligible published exact-CR1 extraplanar creature; this card does not certify its CR or rewrite a bestiary entry. Summon Weaponry Satchel has finite conjured contents tied to one duration, with a narrow exception only for an already resolving immediate use. Alignment Weapon's suppression default applies only to that printed card.

Resonance Well rolls one 1d4 total reserve. Its separately named creation and receipt uses commit before prevention and reset only through each character's beneficial long rest. These limits neither share nor reset Kindle or Mod Rod records. Read the exact cards and [rank-2 status](CONJURATION_RANK2_REVIEW_STATUS.json); pricing/schema checks do not execute these effects or certify balance.

The [rank-3 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK3_EXACT_REVIEW.md) adds seven bounded cards. Earth Pet's knockdown is Prone, not positional movement; generic push/pull immunity does not automatically prevent it. Burst of Flamewind affects every creature the caster ordinarily classifies as an enemy at a known location in its cone, with automatic source damage and a save controlling only its push.

Elemental Displacement selects a nearby willing recipient and a perceived destination; its teleport path is not constrained by intervening terrain. Spectral Steed actually crosses planes to a known site, once per steed attempt. Its 350-pound **and** 12-Load limits count the rider's body and all gear, including melded equipment. The reviewed correction from the conference's proposed6Load avoids excluding all gear from a Medium rider; ordinary Burdened applies at6Load. Read the exact mount/command/arrival procedure; it does not close general mounted combat.

Resonance Conduit transfers already-existing RP between two separate pools, with committed deductions, gated credit, and no resource creation or daily-ledger reset. Renewed consent cannot revive an ended application, but a new legal paid cast may create a new one. Faction Portal provides actual one-way travel to a known HQ on the same or another plane. Its positive-standing predicate uses the current canonical reputation record without migrating its scale. Travel may bypass a geographic route; elapsed clocks, cargo custody, contamination, claims, arrival law and settlement remain actual procedures. These cards do not declare automatic Extraction success or invent a blanket prohibition on planar escape. [Review status](CONJURATION_RANK3_REVIEW_STATUS.json) preserves the manuscript/runtime/balance distinction.

 Noncombat helpers cannot attack or operate combat items.

A cantrip that stabilizes restores no HP and removes no Wound. Mending cannot replace finite machine repair or refresh ammunition, charges, duration or class resources. Created tools, servants and water obey the explicit card limits; a spell does not silently pay wages, produce saleable materials or erase abstract expedition Supply.

All hard whole-Action/turn denial uses one combined **source-character/target/encounter** record across that character's spells, class features and companions. Once used, later hard-denial riders from that source fail; damage and soft riders resolve as printed. Boss immunities remain effective. Same-stat flat bonuses use the strongest; same-name dice bonuses do not stack. Apply one allowed bonus-die spell per roll in this packet unless a reviewed feature explicitly permits more. Temporary HP never add together. Copies never generate copies, class procs or resource loops.

## Falling bridge — new provisional procedure

This is a newly authored table procedure agreed with the GPT notebook, **not recovered V6/Core V2 canon**. Focused searches of the current rulebook extract, Core V2 and mechanics/manual text found spell summaries but no operational falling clock or impact formula. Before promotion to canon, inspect the approved V6 environment/travel/hazard sections and archived environment tables. Preserve any older rule found and compare it explicitly.

When a creature loses support with no movement mode or effect keeping it aloft, it enters **Falling** immediately. Falling means unsupported; it grants no hovering, airborne walking or lateral movement. Track total distance descended during this fall and cumulative distance during its current uncontrolled portion, both initially zero.

**Timing:** If a fall begins during a regular initiative turn, set a fixed Fall Marker at the **end of that initiative slot in the following round**. Resolve the first Falling Step there, then one at the same marker each round. Reactions and extra turns use the enclosing regular initiative slot; an event between slots uses the most recently completed slot. Extra turns, extra Actions and initiative changes neither move nor multiply the marker. This gives every participant one normal turn opportunity before the first descent; inability to act still matters and no free rescue action is granted. A caster still needs legal targets within range when spending their Action.

Outside initiative, when timing matters, establish an order before descent and use a virtual slot immediately before its first regular slot as the initiating slot. The first step occurs when that virtual slot next recurs, after everyone has had one normal turn opportunity. When no rescue or other timing decision is possible, the Director can resolve the same descent and impact calculation directly. This is an explicit timing abstraction, not a model of physical acceleration.

If a fall begins after initiative has been established but before any regular initiative slot has yet completed, treat the virtual pre-round slot as the most recently completed slot for Fall Marker purposes.

**Ordinary descent:** At each step descend up to **300 feet**, stopping on a supporting surface. Add the distance to both trackers. On landing while uncontrolled, take **min(10, floor(uncontrolled distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning damage**. The uncontrolled distance includes earlier steps; never use only the final step's remainder.

**Feather Fall:** The spell retains its **Action** casting time and reduces descent to at most **60 feet per step**. When it takes effect, set uncontrolled distance to zero: the magic dissipates prior uncontrolled momentum in this abstraction. Keep total fall distance. If landing while it remains active, damage is **min(3, floor(total fall distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning**. This explicitly limits impact exposure without guaranteeing a harmless landing. When the spell ends aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero, then accumulate ordinary descent from that point at the existing marker; expiry grants no immediate extra step. Its one-minute maximum ends immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting. If expiry and a step coincide, resolve expiry first. Earlier landing or cessation of Falling ends the spell on that target as printed.

Apply damage defenses only when their actual wording covers that damage. After damage, Falling ends; a creature suffering any positive falling damage lands **Prone** unless an explicit feature prevents it. Less than 20 relevant feet produces zero damage. Forced movement that removes support starts a fall but adds no separate fall damage. Regaining genuine support, secure support from a hold, or flight ends Falling without resolving an uncompleted impact; teleporting safely onto support likewise ends it. A later loss of support begins a new fall with new trackers and marker. Completed impact and damage cannot be undone by later casting.

| Scenario | Steps to land | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary 10 feet | 1 | 0 |
| Ordinary 20 feet | 1 | 1d6 |
| Ordinary 300 feet | 1 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 310 feet | 2 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 610 feet | 3 | 10d6 |
| Feather Fall active through a 310-foot fall | 6 | 3d6 |
| 120 feet slowed, spell ends aloft, then 190 feet uncontrolled | 3 | 9d6 |

The 300-foot ordinary step, impact formulas, momentum reset, marker and duration conventions are provisional inventions. The source supplies Feather Fall's Action, five targets and 60-foot slowed descent. Wider hazards, equipment catches, flight loss and environmental damage still need the combat/campaign pass.

## Recovery bridge and unresolved integration

The class suite's **Retune** formula is the active RP rule for this combined test: recover max(0, floor(maxRP/4 + 0.5) + actual casting modifier), capped at maximum, and clear Dissonance after a completed one-hour short rest. Retain the expedition rule of at most **two beneficial short rests between long rests**, and one beneficial eight-hour long rest per **24 hours**. A long rest restores RP and clears Dissonance; expedition time, supply, pressure, Wounds and rest legality still apply. Count time once, not once in each tracker. Oracle and other non-RP engines use their class-specific recovery, not this formula.

This bridge explicitly chooses the class Retune formula over the gameplay draft's quarter-pool-only RP paragraph. Both originals remain preserved. A completed long rest also resets the remembered spell name and Refrain counter. A short rest clears Dissonance through Retune but does not reset Refrain unless a class feature expressly says so. This reset convention is an explicit provisional decision agreed in the notebook review. Broader recovery decisions for all class resources still require the character/campaign integration pass.

## Developer verification

`tools/spell_playtest_rules.py` checks operational status, class access, level gates, known/prepared membership and the **common pricing step**. Its Dissonance result is deliberately labelled *before class interface*. The caller must apply the actual protected class cadence or vent and verify actions, components, target legality, concentration and effect resolution. This helper is not an automatic implementation of every spell or class.

Run `python tools/build_spell_playtests.py`, then `python tools/validate_spell_playtests.py`. Source accounting, metadata coverage, access boundaries and cost/reference scenarios are independently reported. A passing result does not certify the remaining catalog, all cross-class combinations, human balance or live-app readiness.

`tools/fall_playtest_rules.py` separately exercises the new falling marker and distance/impact calculation. Callers still own actual spell availability/expiry, support, actions, damage rolls, defenses and Prone. Its regression cases specifically prevent premature or duplicate steps, harmless remainder exploits and retroactive changes to resolved landings.


## Reviewed Divination cantrip information boundaries

The [eleven-card review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_DIVINATION_CANTRIP_EXACT_REVIEW.md) and [final source clarification](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_DIVINATION_CANTRIP_FINAL_CLARIFICATION.md) make each spell's information output explicit. Actual hidden facts may be revealed when a spell authorizes them; undefined records must not be invented. Sense Alignment distinguishes recorded axes, Indeterminate and genuinely unaligned objects. Detect Faction requires an actual affiliation/nonaffiliation record; absence of a field is not a negative finding. Resonance Sight reads current RP only, using ordinary visibility and actual pools; unreadability is not proof of no pool.

Protection from Scrying prevents new information about its subject within its actual generating-school scope, including new Far Echo retrieval. It does not erase events, ordinary recordings or known facts, nor grant blanket immunity to Foresight Flicker's roll modifier or Glimpse Future's initiative benefit. Soul Mark's record can remain while its directional information is blocked. The final clarification retains the source's creature eligibility: active creature-classified Undead/Construct targets are not excluded merely by type. Death/destruction/ended summoned existence ends the mark; ordinary shapechange or travel alone does not.

Omen Whisper limits materially equivalent inquiries across casters, while genuinely different material questions can receive another clue. Far Echo uses speech produced in its fixed capture sphere and actually audible at the center in the six seconds before casting. Read Surface Thoughts yields one actual current conscious thought after its save, not memories or forced truth. Detect Weather supplies an accurate current-trajectory forecast; a later actual new cause may alter it, with that cause recorded in the game. These are authored procedures, not a complete information/weather engine or balance certification. See [review status](DIVINATION_CANTRIP_REVIEW_STATUS.json).


## Mark Omen and Fate Coin: reviewed spell-specific rerolls

NEW scoped DE4-GUARD-01 amendment: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from any of these three spells, across all casters, coins, marks, Fate Reversal permissions and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these three spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use stable actor IDs then stable source/application IDs fixed before the original event, with the same stable tie-break for initiative ties. Only the first legal commitment spends its own actual mark, coin or Fate Reversal permission and any Reaction required by that source; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. This guard extension and the explicitly proposed DE4-RNG-05 digital mapping preserve each source's distinct replacement unit and eligibility. Mark Omen still replaces the caster's own marked-target attack d20 procedure with no additional Action or Reaction; Fate Coin still changes exactly one eligible engine RNG die component through its holder's actual Reaction and30-foot perceived-event interface; Fate Reversal still requires its own Reaction, pending permission, eligible complete attack/save/check d20 procedure and60-foot perceived-event interface. No class feature is added to this family merely because it changes a roll, and this amendment grants no new access to hidden dice or any source's otherwise ineligible roll. Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full; its player-information boundaries never grant hidden RNG access.

NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. # Creature companions: life, commands and identity

**REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED: 121 targeted checks and 2,800 Ranger conversion states.** This overlay discusses 100 exact passages from Druid, Mage, Mirrorsage, Ranger and Wizard, supported by five frozen common paragraphs. It closes no full class, form, temporary-HP system or complete runtime by itself. [Source register](CREATURE_LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_BINDINGS.md), [source integrity](CREATURE_LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_VALIDATION.json), [behavior checks](CREATURE_LIFECYCLE_PLAYTEST_VALIDATION.json).

The original class cards and frozen class guide remain intact. The notebook's first classification, boundary reconciliation and event-model decisions are preserved in the audit folder. Where the historical first reply differs from the later boundary replies, the later explicit resolution controls. In particular, Auto-Raise is automatic, its new minion cannot act at all in the creation round, and Mirrorsage Charm was not in the older 219-source control closure.

## At the table

Keep one companion command and one offensive companion allowance per owner per numbered round, including multiclass companions and devices. A normal command costs your Bonus Action. A damaging companion action, or Mage/Wizard control action, spends the offensive allowance. A pure support command spends only the command. The earlier device ledger's internal field named `damage` now represents this shared offensive allowance; its public behavior remains compatible with existing device checks.

Issue ordinary commands during your regular turn. The selected companion moves and performs its command immediately after your whole turn, in an attached phase. It receives no extra independent turn. If it or its target becomes ineligible before execution, the command fails without refund. Your later incapacity or removal alone does not cancel an issued command; actual concentration/source ending can. Uncommanded companions can move defensively and Dodge, subject to their conditions; this grants no generic Reaction or autonomous attack/control.

Use the owner's original regular companion markers for recharge and previous/next-turn references. Extra turns, initiative changes and removal do not restart those markers. The attached phase's event-resolution checkpoint is distinct: it refreshes no Reaction, recharge, Action, death save or regular duration clock.

## Different kinds of creature life

| Creature | HP and 0 HP | Return and identity |
|---|---|---|
| Finite standard summons, Druid swarms, Mage Familiar, Mirror Beasts | HP-only bounded layer; at 0 disappear/end | No corpse, resource or free resummon; a new summon pays its actual source costs |
| Ranger Beast | HP-only; **NEW** immediate death at 0, no Wound checks, Stable or death saves | Actual animal and ordinary surviving corpse; death ends bond. No automatic resurrection or rebond |
| Mage Lich elite | Destroyed bound asset at 0; no usable corpse/resources | Same unique asset remains owned. Soulbound or actual completed LR can return it |
| Wizard standard undead | Destroyed at 0; consumed body never returns as new fuel | Ends on destruction, dismissal or owner's next completed LR, including Auto-Raised minions |
| Wizard elite | Supplied profile/cap only in this package | Binding/acquisition and return procedure are still missing; no create/bind/return API |
| Reflective Companion | Original creature's HP and life rules | Temporary control relation; no copied body, reset, new statistics or duplicate turn |
| Druid form | Same character's HP/life rules | Full forms and Buffer Reserve remain a separate open interface |

Companion healing restores legal normal HP only. It does not reset identity, duration, recharge, actions, source uses, effects or command budgets. Ranger's “heal normally” supplies no Hit Dice pool or automatic rest healing. The HP-only layer is specific to this reviewed companion chassis, not generic law for all animals/NPCs. Existing animal conditions, disease, poison, explicit injuries and timed effects survive bonding.

## Stats and ownership

**NEW:** finite created creatures snapshot base HP and AC at creation. Attacks, saves, class DC and S use the current values of the original source owner at resolution. Keep source owner, current controller, source class and creation source separate. A temporary controller does not donate their class levels, PB or attack bonus. The implementation rejects stats belonging to another owner/class; it provides no unrestricted transfer/rebinding operation.

Standard profile: AC 12 + floor(PB/2), HP 2L, Speed 30, owner PB for saves, one class attack for S d6 with printed melee/ranged mode. Druid swarm uses current PB+WIS, piercing and its printed tiny-gap movement. Familiar snapshots AC 12+PB and HP 5+Mage level+M; its current source-owner Mage attack fires a 30-foot Elemental Dart for S d4. Focus is fixed at creation: Lightning adds Fly30, Fire/Cold their matching resistance. Changing Focus neither morphs nor refills it. One Familiar; replacement ends the prior one.

Ranger maximum is **NEW dynamic** max(1, 2×current Ranger level + actual WIS modifier), not M. Current PB updates its standard AC/saves/attack. Persistent Mage elite maxima use current source-owner Mage level; fixed AC stays fixed. Capacity growth never heals; shrink clamps HP without damage. Wizard elite profiles use the same names with their own original Wizard source statistics if a future legitimate binding source establishes them.

The [reviewed maximum-HP ledger](MAXIMUM_HP_PLAYTEST.md) supplies source-qualified modifiers. Conjuration is the original creating Wizard level snapshot and requires actual Wizard spell creation. Corpse Harvest qualifies only with actual access; Auto-Raise is not a spell and grants no new Conjuration snapshot. Flesh Ascendant is the explicit dynamic eligible-current-controller exception; engine and card are one effect, not two bonuses. Creation starts at full final legal maximum unless the actual source enters damaged; later added capacity never fills HP. Callers update dynamic modifier records from their real sources.

## Ranger's persistent bond

Use the printed one-hour ritual, touch, 4 RP and one long-rest use. The animal must already be willing/tamed, noncorrupted, INT below7 and CR no greater than Ranger level. The helper does not invent finding/taming rules. Keep one chosen movement mode, capped40 feet, and the original keen-sense identity; no monster stat block, boss powers or free special actions. Exact keen-sense selection definitions remain an evidence gap.

**NEW initial conversion:** for a living animal, new HP = max(1, floor(new maximum × old current HP / old maximum)). A wounded animal stays proportionally wounded. This is profile conversion, not healing or damage. A living bound Beast cannot be rebonded to refill HP. On death, ordinary legal resurrection may restore the same animal under its own source, but it remains unbonded. A new full ritual also requires an actual completed long rest after bond death.

Physical body identity is separate from current corpse eligibility. Keep one record whose state is living, corpse, consumed or removed. Accepting an already-resolved, independently legal resurrection immediately marks that same body living and unavailable as a corpse, before any rebond. Corpse Gateway cannot use it while living. A later genuine death with a surviving body makes that same record a corpse again; no fragment/new body identity is generated. A consumed/removed body requires explicit reconstruction by the actual resurrection source before it can return. The notification helper grants no resurrection ability, payment exemption or automatic bond. Rebond uses the actual post-resurrection HP ratio and preserves death history; it cannot claim a healthier ratio. Full global corpse decay/cleanup remains open.

## Mage Lich assets and elite commands

An actual successful Lich transformation unlocks Boneflayer, Dreadblade and Wraithbound. Readiness and informed retirement-risk consent are source guards; this lifecycle helper does not perform that irreversible ritual. **NEW shared identity:** across Mage/Wizard, one owner can have at most one of each named elite and three total. Destroyed assets still occupy those identities. Any future external Wizard binding must validate against the same asset register; the current helper offers only its profile schema.

| Elite | Profile | Source-native actions/riders |
|---|---|---|
| Boneflayer | AC14, HP12+2L, Speed30; ranged60, 2d6+S necrotic | Fear Pulse replaces attack, enemies10 feet WIS or Frightened through target-next-end, recharge3. Grave Miasma replaces attack: radius10 point30 until next owner-start, enemies entry/start1d6 once, recharge3 |
| Dreadblade | AC16, HP16+3L, Speed30; melee5, 1d8+S necrotic | Concentrating hit target immediately saves with disadvantage; natural20 applies printed −1 attack Weakened until target-next-end. Advantage against forced movement |
| Wraithbound | AC14, HP10+2L, Fly40/hover; melee5, 1d8+S necrotic | Natural20 CON or Stunned until target-next-end under shared character→target hard-denial guard |

Rolls, chosen enemy geometry, recharge payments, exact condition applications and canonical hard-guard sharing remain caller/source responsibilities. This helper returns attack profiles and bounded lifecycle/command transitions; it does not silently execute every on-hit effect.

**NEW Miasma integration:** creation spends one offensive command. Its native finite entry/start damage needs no second command and does not spend next round's offense. Retain no-resource/no-recursion flags. An old zone tick is not a new companion turn or attack.

Wraithbound loses source invisibility on attack **or control**. It can regain it at the end of its next original regular companion marker if the predicate remains satisfied. A current-marker end cannot immediately restore it. The actual offense event must notify its marker state. Core Invisible still does not grant unknown location, sight through walls or automatic target legality.

Soulbound requires the destroyed own bound elite within30 or its inert token, legal empty space30, Action, 5 RP and one LR use. Return the same asset/instance at **NEW source-specific** max(1, floor(current maximum/2)), plus S+M temp HP for60 seconds under normal temp-HP rules. Do not copy machine reconstruction permissions. Preserve spent uses, recharge clocks, command history and still-applicable effects. Completed LR returns those same Mage assets at full current HP unless an actual campaign consequence prevents it. Rest-use/recharge resets come only from the canonical rest system; a return itself grants none. Natural effect expiries must still be processed.

## Wizard corpses, standard minions and Auto-Raise

Corpse Harvest costs Action+4 RP, recharge2, legal corpse/space30. Humanoids qualify; actual Infernal Pact also permits Fiends. Skeleton: AC14, HP6+2WizardL, Speed30, ranged30 1d6+S necrotic. Zombie: AC12, HP10+3L, Speed20, melee5 1d8+S. Goblin Thrall: AC13, HP8+2L, Speed30, melee5 1d6+S; requires a goblinoid body even with Pact.

All standard minions and reserved Auto-Raise slots share a cap of3. Manually dismiss an existing standard minion before attempting a fourth; failed creation spends nothing and does not consume the body. Harvest consumes the original body. Summoned, raised, copied, illusory or fragmented remains provide no new corpse fuel. Corpse Gateway uses a legal body without consuming it; it does not grant raising permission. Global corpse decay/removal rules remain open.

Ghoul Lash uses the shared BA command and2 RP with another controlled undead within5 at issuance. Its chosen standard minion makes **two independently rolled normal attacks**, not numerical damage copies. Each can miss/hit/crit. This remains one command and one offensive allowance, with at most one Auto-Raise opportunity.

**NEW queue integration, preserving the printed automatic trigger:** the first qualifying personal killing blow by a standard minion automatically reserves the body, one capacity slot and the killer's mechanical minion type. It spends the owner's round opportunity immediately. Ineligible kills do not spend it; a qualifying trigger cannot voluntarily be declined. Body reservation does not prevent another legal consumer from taking the body first. A destroyed/expired killer does not cancel an already-created reservation.

Resolve after immediate death responses and already-due end damage/saves, before ordinary expiry cleanup, in stable application order. An ordinary attached attack has its own `attachedCompanionEnd` queue checkpoint after its consequences, in the same numbered round. That checkpoint is not a second regular turn marker. Kills before the checkpoint closes may reserve. A later administrative kill cannot reopen it, roll forward or leave an orphan queue; its unused opportunity remains unused unless another independently valid trigger occurs before another legally open checkpoint.

At resolution, still-eligible body, legal space and cap permit creation; otherwise release the reservation but retain the spent round use. Auto-Raise costs no Action or RP. The newborn cannot voluntarily move, Dodge, support, attack, control or react in its creation numbered round. Passive defenses/conditions/expiry continue. It ends at destruction, dismissal or next completed owner LR. Owner unconsciousness/death alone does not invent a new ending.

## Mirror Beast, Reflective Companion and Echo origin

One Mirror Beast **or** Reflective Companion slot. Summoning a Beast replaces the old body/control relation administratively; it never kills the real previously controlled target. Mirrorcall adds M max/current HP at creation and5 Speed. Advanced Mirrorcall spends BA once/encounter for appearance plus its printed swim/climb adjustment; Mirror Shift spends BA+1 RP/recharge2 for swim30 or climb30. Neither heals, restores uses, releases Echoes, grants flight/anatomy, or refreshes duration. Corrupted and Shattered on-hit dice/splash retain their exact once-round source qualifiers; full damage-event execution remains in the later copy/trigger work. Luminant Bond supplies only its printed local WIS-save/Invisible advantage interface, with ordinary cover/targeting intact.

Ordinary Beast: Action2 RP, empty space15, one minute, recharge3. Radiant/Shattered: Action4 RP, empty space15, concentration3 of the owner's regular turns, recharge4. Actual scheduler supplies the precise three-turn endpoint. Radiant chooses attack, BA+1 RP heal S d4 to living ally5, or paid Echo origin, once per numbered round. The healing pipeline resolves rolls/modifiers before the lifecycle HP gain; no invented resurrection.

**NEW Mirror-origin exception:** your Echo resolves immediately as your Action during your own turn, including a real extra own turn if real Action, BA and unused shared caps exist. An extra Action alone supplies no BA. Preflight active Beast, actual record, release cap, owner target perception, current Beast range/LOE, Action, BA and RP before any spend. The Beast grants no remote sensory feed or free preceding movement. You own record consumption, Dissonance, Refrain, concentration and spell damage. BA command is spent; offensive companion allowance is not. A later independently legal Gadget Sync may spend it. No second BA command or second local Beast option appears.

Charm Creature remains Action3 RP, one LR use, WIS save, target INT<=6 within30, concentration at most3 rounds, no PC/boss without actual encounter permission. Repeat save at target's actual turn end and when harmed by your side. No suicide, compelled beliefs or permanent allegiance. Original identity/HP/conditions/effects/stat provenance/initiative remain unchanged. A successful save spends cast costs but does not replace an existing Beast. Source-specific save/Charm immunity and permitted target/route checks remain caller responsibilities.

**NEW hard-denial reconciliation:** initial Charm applies the actual Charmed relation and slot without spending hard denial. While active, one BA may queue at most one pending forced ordinary Action, never unique powers; ordinary attack damage capped S d6. Queue to the next future regular target Action: this round if upcoming, next round if already passed. Pay BA in issue round; reserve offensive allowance in the resolution round. The target receives no duplicate attached turn.

At the designated Action slot, revalidate Charm, capability, legal order and the shared character→target→encounter hard guard. Valid execution replaces that Action and spends both hard guard and offense. If Charm ends, target becomes incapable, legality fails or another same-character feature spends hard denial, cancel and release unused offense; retain BA/costs and do not spend an additional hard denial. Call the pending-order revalidation when those facts change, not only at the future turn. Once a forced Action has occurred, this effect permits no further forced attack, Dodge, movement or replacement Action. Actual Charmed restrictions/repeat saves remain; no new fallback is invented.

## Druid summon dependencies

Base Swarm Summoning: Action, one SR use, space30, concentration10 minutes; independent of form. Carrion Rat King: Action, actual Form Surge, once per shift, one standard swarm for at most60 seconds and only while its parent form remains; replacement affects its old form swarm, not independent Base Swarm. Broodmother: on entry actual Form Surge creates two adjacent bodies with one combined commanded attack; end at the earlier of60 seconds or parent form end. Form change ends those children, not unrelated paid summons.

Master of Vermin substitutes the paid summoning spell's profile while preserving its actual count, duration and concentration. No extra casts, creatures or command budget. Its independently paid spell creatures do not inherit a form-ending dependency solely from that substitution. Full forms, reserve arithmetic, per-form special actions and temporary-HP effects remain open.

## Reference boundaries and next work

The helper requires certified source access, legal target/space/range/LOE/perception, ordinary condition capability, real paid Form Surge, canonical action wallets/use scopes, actual concentration/clock endpoints and actual completed rest events. These are explicit inputs, not guessed by creature names. A fresh wallet/ledger per ability is invalid integration. Recharge/frequency keys represent already validated canonical scopes; caller must not mint a new key to bypass them.

Open: Wizard elite binding/return, real Beast natural rest and keen-sense details, global corpse cleanup, broader companion families, full forms/tempHP, complete damage/copy/proc execution, ordinary spell and content catalogs, human balance and complete runtime. Classification of incidental source passages is not closure of their complete effects.

[Final notebook disposition](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CREATURE_LIFECYCLE_FINAL_CLOSURE.md) approves only the selected100+5 source roles and interfaces described here. Incidental full-form/tempHP effects remain deferred.


## Dominate Beast integration

The [reviewed rank-three Enchantment supplement](ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md) adds the source-qualified Dominate Beast bridge for actual Beast companions. It redirects only an existing owner-attached execution opportunity, preserves original profile/source-owner stats, reuses a same-companion/same-phase pending reservation where applicable, and occupies the original owner's structural command/offense caps without charging that owner's Bonus Action. It grants no independent companion turn, duplicate phase or new resource pool. The prior lifecycle text above remains intact; the new bridge is an authored manuscript addition whose stateful runtime integration remains open.

# Damage sharing, prevention and interception

**REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED —39 exact source passages and two supporting Tinker engine passages.** [Final notebook review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_REDIRECTION_FINAL_CLOSURE.md) closes this bounded damage-sharing interface with94 checks and186 conservation states. It does not establish every item/spell defense, companion lifecycle, all-source attack chain or numerical balance. Original source cards remain unchanged.

Read the [source register](REDIRECTION_SOURCE_BINDINGS.md), [source checks](REDIRECTION_SOURCE_VALIDATION.json), [reference checks](REDIRECTION_PLAYTEST_VALIDATION.json), [first notebook proposal](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_REDIRECTION_FIRST_REVIEW_PARTIAL.md) and [complete corrections](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_REDIRECTION_BOUNDARIES.md). Later corrections supersede the retained first proposal.

## Resolve the kind of protection first

Guardian Pulse changes the target of an attack before comparing its original roll with AC. The Guardian becomes the actual hit/miss and on-hit-rider target. One attack can be retargeted once. Multiple offers are chosen by the original intended target; only the selected Guardian spends its Reaction/use. After the incoming attack fully resolves, a surviving, eligible Guardian may make the printed counterattack against an attacker in reach whether the original attack hit or missed. This free attack cannot grant another free attack or Action. Retargeting does not spend the later damage-transfer opportunity.

Bloodbond and Veinlock Tether divide the finalized raw damage before either recipient's mitigation. Attack/save success, save-halving and critical dice have already determined that amount. Bloodbond transfers one quarter, rounded down; Veinlock instead chooses up to S+M. Each recipient applies its own eligible defenses once to its own share.

Other supplied damage transfers divide damage after the original target's defenses and legal pure prevention, before temporary HP. Their transferred portions keep damage type and skip another DR/resistance/immunity/prevention stage. Temporary HP, applicable HP floors, would-die replacements, Wounds, concentration and ordinary life consequences still apply. “Unmitigated damage” does not mean “death cannot be prevented.”

Pure prevention removes damage without creating a second recipient. Elemental Absorption adds its resistance during ordinary defenses. Aura of Bonds and Crown reductions use the strongest applicable class flat reduction, then resistance/immunity. Finite/reactive prevention such as Bloom and Ancestral Guardian follows those defenses before post-defense transfer and temporary HP. Verify additional item/spell sources before treating this as universal defense ordering.

Redirecting Palm prevents half the Monk's post-defense damage, rounded down. The Monk keeps the remainder. A second enemy distinct from the triggering melee attacker, within5feet, can receive new force damage equal to the prevented amount, capped at Monk level. That new damage gets its own defenses; it is not a transferred attack or critical hit. With no second enemy, the Monk still receives the reduction.

Direct HP payments from Blood Sacrifice, Flesh-to-RP, Profane Exchange and Channel Life stay outside the damage sequence. They bypass temporary HP, obey their own legal minimum HP and do not create damage/Wound/resource triggers from paying the cost. Healing-recipient substitution and excess-healing conversion also remain distinct operations.

## One transfer operation and exact amounts

A root here means one original recipient's damage packet. A shared area cast has a separate root for each original recipient, under the same cast/roll identity.

One such root accepts one damage-sharing operation across all owners. A pre-mitigation split locks both its retained original portion and transferred portions against later transfer. Burden Shared can divide one operation among up to two other explicitly willing recipients. It does not create two redirection events. No transferred recipient may be the original damage target.

**New stage-precedence integration:** consider pre-mitigation offers before applying defenses, and post-defense offers afterward. Within the same stage, select eligible positive mandatory/automatic protection before optional offers; competing mandatory claims are chosen by the original damage target. A legally chosen Bloodbond/Veinlock operation can therefore preempt later Aegis/Final Stand because that root is already claimed. Do not preview or consume defenses/Bloom to decide a later-stage preference. The helper accepts an already selected legal operation; it does not select Reactions or schedule automatic offers.

Optional transfer requires a positive chosen amount and available damage. Zero transfer cannot spend an optional Reaction/resource/use. A mandatory rounded-zero share does nothing and spends no transfer allowance. An independently legal prevention component can still occur.

| Source | Transferred amount |
|---|---|
| Bloodbond | floor(raw damage/4), fixed |
| Veinlock Tether / Shared Breath / Selfless Guardian | chosen up to S+M |
| Protective Stance / Emergency Protocols | min(S+M, available damage), fixed |
| Life Linked | chosen up to floor(available damage/2) |
| Guardian Tissue | floor(available damage/3), fixed |
| Aegis Incarnate / Martyr's Share | floor(available damage/2), fixed |
| Chainbound Smite | chosen up to max(3, actual CHA modifier) |
| Linked Ward | chosen up to max(2, twice actual CHA modifier) |
| King's Smite protection | chosen up to5 |
| Aura of the Crown | chosen up to M |
| Crown of Embers / Burden Shared | chosen up to level+M |
| Crown Undying | chosen up to remaining level+M round allowance |
| Final Stand | all available damage, subject to shared allowance |

Every amount is capped by the available packet at its source's stage. Fixed fractions/fixed protection cannot voluntarily choose a smaller amount. Original actions, range, willingness, costs, active-state requirements, cadence and source-specific use limits still apply.

## Hit identity and final damage accounting

The original damage target retains its original hit, failed-save, critical and on-hit-rider identity even if all damage is transferred. A rider that requires positive damage must recheck the actual remaining packet. A transferred recipient was not hit by that attack and did not fail its save; it receives no attached poison/control/maiming/knockout rider merely because damage moved.

Accordingly, transferred damage from a critical attack gives an already0HP recipient the ordinary one damage failure, not two critical-hit failures. Concentration still sees the transferred recipient's resolved packet even if temporary HP absorbs all of it.

Use the [reviewed life-state interface](HEALING_DEATH_PLAYTEST.md) after resolving each final recipient. Numeric actual damage is temporary HP absorbed plus actual normal HP lost, excluding overkill and damage prevented by an HP floor. Sum each terminal recipient once. Do not also count the unsplit parent or unrelated counterdamage.

Physical root totals include every recipient. A healing/resource/reflection consumer sums only branches permitted for that consumer and qualifying for its own source's target predicate. For example, a meaningful-hostile-only drain does not automatically count damage transferred onto a friendly protector. Check all applicable flags for a compound trigger, such as a passive healing proc.

## Source-specific restrictions

All transfers prohibit another transfer. All supplied post-defense transfers prohibit another mitigation/prevention stage. Further restrictions differ:

| Source family | Additional restrictions on transferred damage |
|---|---|
| Paladin engine | No reflection or resource generation; does not universally prohibit other retaliation or healing |
| Protective Stance | Also no generic damage-trigger chains |
| Burden Shared | Also no derived healing |
| Oracle Life Linked | No reflection, resource/RC, passive, condition, action or copy generation; no recovery or retaliation |
| Guardian Tissue / Aegis | No BT generation; no invented ban on every other resource |
| Shared Breath | No additional generic trigger prohibition |
| Selfless Guardian / Emergency Protocols | No retaliation chain |
| Bloodbond / Veinlock | Each recipient still has its one defense stage; no additional blanket prohibition |

A no-derived-healing flag does not prevent unrelated later healing of the recipient.

The source's explicit redirection riders remain narrowly available. Unbroken Covenant triggers on the redirection operation, even when Protective Stance prohibits generic damage triggers; use half the final protector actual damage, capped at S+M. These self-absorption riders require damage actually transferred to the redirecting owner, not to another ally under Burden Shared. Linked Ward's own transfer granting temporary HP on reducing the Paladin to0 uses final actual damage, capped at level+M. Final Stand also gives the protected ally temporary HP equal to Paladin level and resistance to all damage through that ally's next turn end; the numeric helper handles only temporary HP, and the caller must create the resistance record. None grants a generic permission to ignore other source restrictions. Temporary HP still uses the larger remaining amount and does not stack.

## Paladin round ledger

Track each Paladin owner's numbered-round events. Ordinarily, one redirection event is available, using exactly one Paladin redirection feature. Final Stand is automatic on the first eligible positive post-defense packet while its allowance remains; the Paladin cannot save it for a later hit. Its “all damage” text does not override the explicit engine ceiling. It may redirect again in a later numbered round if still active before its source-next-start deadline.

Crown Undying can raise the owner's total to two different damage events, with at most one ordinary/non-Crown feature. The additional permission belongs to Crown Undying. A prior ordinary redirection remains recorded if Crown activates later in the same round; only one further Crown event is then possible. Reapplication does not clear history.

The two Crown events may protect the same selected ally. Sum Crown-transferred amounts against level+M per round. Its heal is floor(final Paladin branch actual damage/2) for each event, then capped by the remaining S+M per protected ally that round. Commit that nominal source entitlement before target healing restrictions; blocked or capped healing refunds no event, transfer amount or healing entitlement. The heal cannot heal the Paladin or start another redirection/heal-copy chain.

## Bloom and devices

Bloom Ward is a finite10+Oracle-level prevention pool across packets. Apply its legal prevention after ordinary defenses. Subtract only the prevented amount. The bloom ends on depletion, its1minute expiry, or actual legal removal. Suppression alone does not end it. Ending grants the printed +1 Frightened-save rider through the target's next end. A late clock observation must retain the endpoint calculated from the actual expiry, not create a fresh duration. An unmitigated transferred branch cannot consume this prevention pool.

Emergency Protocols requires an active/conscious drone within its printed range. The transfer occurs after the Tinker's defenses and before temporary HP. The drone receives the bounded transferred amount without mitigation; legally granted temporary HP can absorb it. At0HP the drone is destroyed and receives no organic Wound or death-save procedure.

Tinker engine[2] retains the destroyed drone at0 until its explicit repair/rebuild procedure. Ordinary functional repair cannot reconstruct a destroyed drone or reset ammunition, uses, duration or command budget. This package's device helper only resolves damage/destruction; it does not implement reconstruction or grant a destruction reward. The broader companion/device lifecycle remains open.

## Reference boundary

The helper validates arithmetic, stages, branch identity, replay protection and round entitlements. Callers establish legal sources, target relationships, exact source cadence, action/resource payment, clock endpoints and source-native riders. No helper imports card ownership merely from a string identifier. The source register preserves every exact original procedure alongside the overlay.

Guardian Pulse's new counterattack carries its explicit no-further-free-attack/no-Action limits, without inheriting unrelated incoming healing/resource/reflection restrictions. Palm's force damage has no invented copy/action/resource prohibition; each downstream source determines eligibility. It cannot trigger another Palm because it is not a melee attack.

Validation currently covers94 targeted checks and186 conservation states. Full-game completion, human balance and all-source combat/device execution remain separate unfinished work.
